cwe_descriptions: CWE-200: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor — The product exposes sensitive information to an actor that is not explicitly authorized to have access to that information.
CWE-863: Incorrect Authorization — The product performs an authorization check when an actor attempts to access a resource or perform an action, but it does not correctly perform the check.
CWE-921: Storage of Sensitive Data in a Mechanism without Access Control — The product stores sensitive information in a file system or device that does not have built-in access control.
